```yaml
name: Compile Time Tracker

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  compile-time-tracking:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        submodules: recursive
        
    - name: Setup Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.10'
        
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake libboost-all-dev libeigen3-dev
        pip install -r requirements.txt
        
    - name: Configure CMake
      run: |
        mkdir build
        cd build
        cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
        
    - name: Build project
      run: |
        cd build
        make -j$(nproc)
        
    - name: Run compile time analysis
      run: |
        cd build
        # Run compile time tracking analysis
        ./compile_time_tracker --output=compile_times.json
        
    - name: Upload compile times
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      with:
        name: compile-times
        path: build/compile_times.json
        
    - name: Check for performance regressions
      run: |
        # Add logic to check if compile times have regressed
        echo "Checking for compile time regressions..."
        # This would typically involve comparing against baseline
        # For now, we'll just verify the build succeeded
        if [ -f "build/compile_times.json" ]; then
          echo "Compile time tracking completed successfully"
        else
          echo "Error: Compile time tracking failed"
          exit 1
        fi
```
